fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Follows the reek to an enemy at or below 30% health and bites for 20 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target already carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: Coat Shudder
fusions.desc: Bounds to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and shakes the musk out of your coat, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. The poison spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Whole Pack Reeks
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Doused Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving its target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
